principle: Apply Danny's v12 review notes while removing every z-axis cue from the number studies. Digits remain on a flat plane: their assigned size and opacity do not change over time. Dense number fields, stronger 2D background events, full-frame panel travel, and two intentional loop resets are tested while PDE-002 and subject geometry remain fixed.

recipes.name: Dense varied-size 2D drift
recipes.description: A dense flat field of single digits drifts slowly in two dimensions. Sizes are evenly distributed once and remain fixed, so nothing grows, shrinks, advances, or recedes.

recipes.name: Dense same-size 2D plane
recipes.description: All digits share one fixed size on a single flat plane and move slowly together around the frame, with edge entries and exits but no scale or depth change.

recipes.name: Orderly 2D separation field
recipes.description: A denser, orderly field separates laterally around the subject and returns. The changing relationship comes only from x-y position; each digit keeps its assigned 2D size.

recipes.name: Visible 2D gradient curtain
recipes.description: A stronger two-tone vertical gradient travels fully across the background and back so the event is visible rather than merely measurable.

recipes.name: Full-width sliding panel
recipes.description: The panel enters from the right, crosses all the way to the left edge, and returns within 11 seconds using eased acceleration and deceleration.

recipes.name: Eleven-second hinged door
recipes.description: The hinged plane begins opening immediately and spends the full 11 seconds disappearing. The loop deliberately resets to the next closed door instead of disguising the cut.

recipes.name: Dense 2D number wipe
recipes.description: A very dense, flat field of varied-size digits is erased from right to left by a full-frame panel. The hard loop reset restores the number field and restarts the wipe.
